summary: Sorts table DAT rows or columns by a selected row/column name or index, with alphabetical, alphanumeric, numeric, random, unique, preserve-first, and reverse options.

key_params.name: sortmethod
key_params.note: Sort rows or columns by name/index, or preserve input order for post-processing

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Row or column name selector used by name-based sort modes

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Row or column index selector used by index-based sort modes

key_params.name: order
key_params.note: Alphabetical, alphanumeric, numeric, or random sort order

key_params.name: seed
key_params.note: Random seed used for random sorting

key_params.name: preservefirst
key_params.note: Keep the first row or column in place

key_params.name: unique
key_params.note: Remove duplicate row/column entries by single cell or entire row/column

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: If the sort name is not found, the output is unsorted; if the index is -1 or out of bounds, the output is unsorted.
Alphabetical sorting treats numbers as characters; use alphanumeric or numeric sorting for natural numeric order.
Numeric sorting treats non-numeric characters as 0 while preserving incoming order for ties.
Unique Output changes row or column count and can break downstream fixed-index lookups.
Preserve First is commonly needed for headers but changes the effective sort domain.
key_concepts: Sorts table DAT rows or columns.
Sort mode chooses row versus column sorting by name, index, or preserved input order.
Order can be alphabetical, numeric, or shuffled/randomized depending on settings.
Preserve First, Unique Output, and Reverse Output alter sorted table shape and ordering.
